courses.title: Kindraya® Ancestral Healing Session
courses.description: A one-hour session over Zoom in Dr. Lotte's own Kindraya method of ancestral work. Working from a questionnaire about your family line, she traces patterns and unresolved burdens handed down through the generations and holds a space for releasing them with your ancestors.

courses.title: Trance Healing Session
courses.description: A thirty-minute online session in which Dr. Lotte goes into deep meditation and acts as a channel between the client and the spirit world for healing energy. No messages are passed on; the client simply rests and receives, and the page presents it as a spiritual practice alongside, not instead of, medical care.

left_out: Medical Intuitive & Wellness session ($299.00 USD, https://drlotte.com/medical-intuitive-wellness-session): sold for 'mysterious health issues', with a medical medium reading of the client's health and suggestions of tests to ask a physician for; medical work, still out. Supplements and at-home tests: medical products, still out.
